How to pay

Pay online by FPX online banking, card or eWallet in one step. Or pay by DuitNow QR:

  1. Send your order on WhatsApp. Your total already includes delivery.
  2. Pay the total with the DuitNow QR below, using Touch ’n Go or any banking app.
  3. Send your receipt in the same WhatsApp chat. We’ll confirm and pack your order.
